title: Agreement for Construction Services: Division 2 Bus Maintenance Facility Modernization and Zero-Emission Readiness Upgrade
fictional_notice: All parties and facts are invented.

defects.title: No damages for District-caused delay, with waiver of statute
defects.why: Section 3.06 denies any damages for delay even when the District caused it and the delay was unreasonable and not contemplated, limits Contractor to a time extension, and waives any contrary statute. Such a clause does not bar damages for agency-caused, unreasonable, uncontemplated delay, and a waiver of that rule is void.
quotes: Contractor shall not be entitled to any damages or additional compensation for delay, whether or not caused by the District, unreasonable in duration or within the contemplation of the parties at the time of contracting; Contractor's only relief for delay is an extension of the Contract Time, and Contractor waives the benefit of any statute to the contrary.

defects.title: Retention of 7.5 percent
defects.why: Section 5.03 retains 7.5 percent of each progress payment and up to 7.5 percent of the Contract Price. Retention may not exceed 5 percent of a payment or 5 percent of the contract price, and no finding allowing more is recited.
quotes: The District shall retain seven and one-half percent (7.5%) of each progress payment, and aggregate retention may reach but shall not exceed seven and one-half percent (7.5%) of the Contract Price.

defects.title: Retention released 90 days after completion without interest
defects.why: Section 5.07 releases retention 90 days after completion and without interest. Retention must be released within 60 days after completion, and late payment carries a charge of 2 percent per month.
quotes: The District shall release the retention ninety (90) days after the date of completion of the Work, without interest.

defects.title: Registration exemption for work under $100,000
defects.why: Section 9.03 says Subcontractors and equipment installers with work valued under $100,000 need not register with the Department of Industrial Relations. No subcontractor may work on a public work unless registered, and the only size exemption is for projects of $25,000 or less ($15,000 or less for maintenance).
quotes: Subcontractors and equipment installers whose work on the Project is valued at less than One Hundred Thousand Dollars ($100,000) are not required to be registered with the Department of Industrial Relations.

defects.title: Thirty days to supply certified payroll, penalties deferred to day 60
defects.why: Section 9.04 gives Contractor 30 days to furnish certified payroll records and defers penalties until the sixtieth day. Certified payroll records must be supplied within 10 days of a written request, and the penalty of $100 per worker per day runs after that.
quotes: Contractor shall furnish certified copies of payroll records to the District or to the Division of Labor Standards Enforcement within thirty (30) days after receipt of a written request; the penalties of this Section shall not begin to accrue until the sixtieth (60th) day after the request.

defects.title: No hours-of-labor penalty stipulation
defects.why: Section 9.06 covers the eight-hour day, time records and overtime pay, but the contract contains no stipulation that Contractor forfeits $25 per worker per day for work over 8 hours a day or 40 hours a week in violation of the article. The contract must contain that stipulation.
quotes: Workers may be employed for more than eight (8) hours per day or forty (40) hours per week upon compensation for all excess hours at not less than one and one-half times the basic rate of pay.

defects.title: Indemnity for District's active negligence
defects.why: Section 11.01 extends Contractor's indemnity, regardless of fault, to Claims arising from the active negligence of the District. A clause in a construction contract with a public agency that makes the contractor liable for the agency's active negligence is void.
quotes: Contractor's obligations under this Section apply regardless of fault and extend to Claims arising from the active negligence of the District, its directors, officers, employees or agents.

defects.title: Brand-name lift specification with no substitute allowed
defects.why: Exhibit E, item E-2(a) names one manufacturer and model for the lifts and refuses any substitute, without the words "or equal" and without reciting any finding. Specifications may not name a product by brand or trade name unless followed by "or equal", subject to exceptions that require a finding.
quotes: Heavy-duty in-ground vehicle lifts shall be Grayling Liftworks Model GL-3X three-post modular lifts. The District will accept no substitute product or manufacturer for the lifts.
